model_notes: The structure of the redcap database was not fully able to capture the dynamics of transmission in the model. The model is a deterministic compartmental model with an SEI component for mosquitoes and SEIR for humans and livestock. Livestock and humans experience disease induced mortality. The authors assume that humans cannot infect vectors. Vectors can infect humans and livestock but that also humans can become infected through direct contact with livestock. Have selected animals - domesticated because the animals in the model are livestock. Homogeneous mixing assumption derived from model equations but not explicitly stated.
